samples.question: This picture shows a scattered sewing kit on a plain white background. Exactly one item is drawn in a strong colour: a single round button, drawn as one filled coloured disc. Every other mark is plain grey - including grey discs that also have holes - and every grey mark is decoration that must be ignored; no grey mark touches or overlaps the coloured button. A hole is a background-coloured opening lying completely inside the coloured disc; the holes never touch one another and never reach the rim of the disc. A button in this picture may have any number of holes. How many holes does the coloured button have? Answer with exactly one of: 2, 3, 4, 5.
